name: print-social-coral-locked-in-or-not-savings-ad-with-hand-held-phone-on-sofa
title: Locked In or Not Savings Ad in Coral
whatItIs: A square coral ad with faint mountain shapes and a logo, a giant white heavy caps headline 'LOCKED IN OR NOT?', a lighter line 'Save NGN or USD with Fixed and Flexible plans', a cream pill 'USE BUSHA', and a dark hand with a chain bracelet holding a phone with a wavy bezel showing a savings plans screen against a maroon sofa.
whatItMeans: Warm coral and a maroon sofa make a savings product feel cosy, and a punny headline gives it personality.
techniques: Giant heavy caps headline with a question
Tonal maroon sofa behind the hand
Faint pattern in the coral ground

vocabulary.definition: A headline using wordplay tied to the product.
A phone case with rippled edges.
A background in a related shade to the main colour.
